messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Below is a **complete list of long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023**.  
The table shows the holiday name, the date it fell on, the day of the week, and the full weekend that was extended (Saturday → Monday).  

> **Important:**  
> *Federal holidays (e.g., Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving) apply nationwide.*  
> *Some holidays are province‑specific (e.g., Family Day, Civic Holiday).*  
> *If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is usually the following Monday, which is the day that actually creates the long weekend.*  

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Weekend Extended (Sat‑Mon) | Province‑specific? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|----------------------------|--------------------|
| New Year’s Day (Observed) | Jan 2 | Mon | Jan 1‑2 | No |
| Family Day (Alberta, BC, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 18‑20 | Yes |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7‑9 | No |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | May 20‑22 | No |
| Canada Day (Observed) | Jul 3 | Mon | Jul 1‑3 | No |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 2‑4 | No |
| Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Aug 7 | Mon | Aug 5‑7 | Yes |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 7‑9 | No |
| Remembrance Day (Observed) | Nov 13 | Mon | Nov 11‑13 | No |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 23‑25 | No |

### Quick‑reference JSON (easy to import)

```json
[
  {"holiday":"New Year’s Day (Observed)","date":"2023-01-02","weekend":["2023-01-01","2023-01-02"]},
  {"holiday":"Family Day","date":"2023-02-20","weekend":["2023-02-18","2023-02-20"]},
  {"holiday":"Good Friday","date":"2023-04-07","weekend":["2023-04-07","2023-04-09"]},
  {"holiday":"Victoria Day","date":"2023-05-22","weekend":["2023-05-20","2023-05-22"]},
  {"holiday":"Canada Day (Observed)","date":"2023-07-03","weekend":["2023-07-01","2023-07-03"]},
  {"holiday":"Labour Day","date":"2023-09-04","weekend":["2023-09-02","2023-09-04"]},
  {"holiday":"Civic Holiday","date":"2023-08-07","weekend":["2023-08-05","2023-08-07"]},
  {"holiday":"Thanksgiving","date":"2023-10-09","weekend":["2023-10-07","2023-10-09"]},
  {"holiday":"Remembrance Day (Observed)","date":"2023-11-13","weekend":["2023-11-11","2023-11-13"]},
  {"holiday":"Christmas Day","date":"2023-12-25","weekend":["2023-12-23","2023-12-25"]}
]
```

### CSV format

```
holiday,date,weekend_start,weekend_end
New Year’s Day (Observed),2023-01-02,2023-01-01,2023-01-02
Family Day,2023-02-20,2023-02-18,2023-02-20
Good Friday,2023-04-07,2023-04-07,2023-04-09
Victoria Day,2023-05-22,2023-05-20,2023-05-22
Canada Day (Observed),2023-07-03,2023-07-1,2023-07-03
Labour Day,2023-09-04,2023-09-02,2023-09-04
Civic Holiday,2023-08-07,2023-08-05,2023-08-07
Thanksgiving,2023-10-09,2023-10-07,2023-10-09
Remembrance Day (Observed),2023-11-13,2023-11-11,2023-11-13
Christmas Day,2023-12-25,2023-12-23,2023-12-25
```

Feel free to drop the JSON or CSV into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Quebec, Civic Holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.), let me know and I can expand the list accordingly!
